instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show what my AI did", and give it database. To see how one item came about, give item too.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-ai-activity and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: the newest rows as items with next_before to page on, or with item the steps of its trace.
